entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Again? How many of 'em are there?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess this won't be as easy as we were[n]thinking.
entries.uk: Схоже, усе буде не так легко, як ми[n]думали.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is she jumping in front of a car?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Could this be the moment when[n]Futaba's mother committed suicide?
entries.uk: Невже це мить, коли мама Футаби[n]наклала на себе руки?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...She died right in front of Futaba's eyes.
entries.uk: ...Вона загинула просто на очах у Футаби.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So, did her desire to forget those[n]memories cause her to repress them?
entries.uk: То вона витіснила ці спогади, бо[n]прагнула їх забути?
